summary: Verified DynoPay SEO landing pages fix on preview. All 8 country pages, all 6 vertical pages, homepage-link integrity, sitemap coverage, and unknown-slug 404 regressions PASS (19/19 pytest tests). Dockerfile and getStaticPaths code changes confirmed in source.
critical_code_review_comments: Dockerfile:41 has 'COPY data/ ./data/' in frontend-builder; Dockerfile:129 has 'COPY --from=frontend-builder /app/data ./frontend/data' in runner - verified.
Dockerfile.frontend:40 has 'COPY data/ ./data/' in builder; Dockerfile.frontend:90 has 'COPY --from=builder /app/data ./data' in runner - verified.

pages/accept-crypto-payments-in/[country].tsx and pages/for/[vertical].tsx both throw 'SEO build error: ... check Dockerfile COPY data/ ./data/' when slugs are empty - verified (lines 32-37 in both files).
The throw-on-empty guard is correctly placed in getStaticPaths so a future missing-data regression will fail the build loudly instead of silently shipping 404s.
test_credentials: None required — all pages are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://repo-link-setup.preview.emergentagent.com runs Next.js DEV mode. All 8 country slugs (united-states, united-kingdom, germany, india, nigeria, brazil, turkey, vietnam) and 6 vertical slugs (ecommerce, saas, freelancers, gaming, remittance, digital-downloads) render 200 with valid H1 and country/vertical content. Homepage has SEO links that all 200. /sitemap.xml contains all 14 URLs. Unknown slugs correctly return 404 without crashing subsequent requests. Production fix will apply only after user redeploys with the updated Dockerfiles. Test file kept as regression at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_pages.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (already identified & fixed by main agent): Docker build stages copied every frontend source dir EXCEPT data/, so at build time utils/seoContent.ts fs.existsSync('data/seo-pages/...') returned false → getAllCountrySlugs/getAllVerticalSlugs returned [] → getStaticPaths emitted zero paths → with fallback:false Next.js shipped no country/vertical pages, silently 404-ing in production while dev/preview worked because the code ran from the repo root. Fix: added 'COPY data/ ./data/' to builder stages and 'COPY --from=... /app/data ...' to runner stages in both /app/Dockerfile and /app/Dockerfile.frontend; hardened getStaticPaths to throw when slugs.length === 0 so a future regression will fail the docker build instead of silently shipping 404s.
